text:
Jordan: Quick sync — we're scheduling a base-image rebuild to enforce seccomp, remove setuid bits, and roll in the compact runtime kernel patches. Need help deciding signer RBAC and KMS audit wiring before the cutover. Who owns the keystore roles?

Sophia: I can own the RBAC doc. question: do we want the signer SA to have direct decrypt/sign perms on the keystore, or should we use an intermediate signing proxy?

Jordan: Prefer proxy for blast radius, but worried about latency and having to run another long-lived component in staging. Thoughts?

Tanvi: Proxy is better for principle of least privilege. We can have the proxy authenticate to KMS using short-lived tokens minted by STS. That avoids giving the builder SA broad key access.

Mike: Agree with Tanvi. Also need audit logs forwarded to the central SIEM. Today KMS logs go to cloud-logs project but we need per-repo image-sign events tagged with repo and pipeline id.

Jordan: Good point. Who can update log sinks and ensure we include signer metadata?

Sophia: I can open a PR for an IAM role change and a log-sink request. Minimal change: create signer-proxy-sa with iam.serviceAccounts.get and iam.serviceAccounts.actAs, plus kms.cryptoSign permission on specific key.

Tanvi: Example policy snippet I tested locally:
```
bindings:
  - role: roles/cloudkms.cryptoSigner
    members:
      - serviceAccount:signer-proxy@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com
  - role: roles/logging.logWriter
    members:
      - serviceAccount:signer-proxy@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```
This scopes it to the signing key only.

Mike: For audit we should add an annotation in the signed manifest with `signer: signer-proxy` + `build_id`. Then SIEM can correlate KMS log entries with the image manifest.

sec-bot: Reminder: New signer SA must be added to the Key Access Review (KAR) spreadsheet before keys are granted. See https://internal.redwood/kar.

Jordan: Noted. Also security asked for event-level logging for every sign operation (principal, key_version, signature_id, image_sha). Is that available from KMS?

Tanvi: KMS provides admin and data access logs. We'll need to parse data access logs for Encrypt/Decrypt/Sign calls. I can add a structured payload in the proxy to emit a `sign_event` to audit-log topic as well so we have richer fields (image_sha, repo, pipeline).

Sophia: +1. That gives us a single canonical place for downstream tooling. Make sure the proxy signs with the minimal key version and includes an `x-request-id` header matching build id.

Mike: Ops concern: during the rebuild we may need to re-sign existing images in the registry. Re-signing at scale could hit our KMS quota. Let's throttle with backoff and pre-warm key versions.

Tanvi: Good catch — add exponential backoff and a small token-bucket on the re-sign worker. We can also request a temporary quota increase for the maintenance window.

Jordan: Who will coordinate the quota request and the maintenance calendar?

Mike: I can file the quota request with cloud support and stub a runbook for the re-sign batch, including healthchecks and rollback steps.

Sophia: I'll draft the RBAC change PR and the signer-proxy README with deployment, env vars, and required KMS bindings. PR link when ready.

Jordan: For canaries: let's run the proxy in staging and sign a handful of images, validate attestations, then do a small production canary — no mass re-sign until logs and metrics look good.

devops-bot: Deploy scheduled: signer-proxy v0.3 -> staging at 2024-12-02T03:00Z (automated by CI).

Jordan: Perfect. Last ask from security: add a post-deploy authz review step to the release checklist (ensure we rotated any long-lived creds and updated KAR).

Tanvi: Will add checklist item. Also adding a smoke test that verifies `cosign verify` against the new signatures and that KMS logs show the `CryptoSign` RPCs for the key.

Mike: One more: include emergency rollback command in runbook: `gcloud logging read "protoPayload.methodName=\"cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.sign\" AND resource.labels.key_id=\"projects/.../cryptoKeys/…\"" --limit=50` to confirm no unexpected sign spikes.

Jordan: Great. I'll follow up with the schedule and assign tasks. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

sec-bot: Action items created: KAR entry pending, RBAC PR assigned to Sophia, quota request assigned to Mike, proxy smoke tests assigned to Tanvi.

Sophia: PR: https://git.internal.redwood/repo/infra/+/1234 — includes IAM and deploy notes.

Jordan: Closing the thread — will post the maintenance window + runbook link once Mike's quota is approved.

Mike: 👍
